import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'
import { InputGroup, InputGroupAddon, InputGroupInput } from '@/components/ui/input-group'

export default function Particle() {
  return (
    <InputGroup>

        <Button size="xs" variant="secondary">
          Search

}
